sections.heading: CVX — Chevron
sections.markdown:
**Signal / why now:** #12 GLOBAL MOMENTUM at $225.71, sitting exactly AT the 52-week high (mom12 +38.3%, mom6 +23.5%, mom1 +10.8%). Energy is the one un-covered GLOBAL sector, so CVX is the deliberate rotation probe — but the screen signal is a war-premium bid, not a fundamental inflection.

**Archetype:** commodity_capex_turnaround (rate 0.42, up +75%, down −35%, 3y). Method card: VAL_COMMODITY_CYCLICAL. EV = +11.2% on the prior.

**3 questions a deep-dive would answer (moot at DISCARD):**
1. Is the Jun-26 quarter (revenue $67.2bn, EBIT $14.3bn, vs $3–4bn EBIT in each of the three prior quarters) a real step-change in realizations, or a one-off disposition/settlement?
2. Is the 103.7% payout covered by through-cycle FCF at $70 Brent, or is CVX distributing the down-cycle?
3. Does the desk's "war premium is an overlay — do not chase" stance leave any entry window at all?

**Fast-disqualify:** EV positive ✓ (+11.2%). **Valuation target FAILS.** FY2025 EPS $6.63 (vs $18.28 in FY2022) puts the entry at 34x depressed earnings; the +75% base-rate up-leg implies ~60x. Revenue has declined three straight years ($235.7bn → $184.4bn), net margin is 6.7%, ROE 6.6%, and the dividend is funded beyond earnings. This is the archetype's incentive-price trap run in reverse — a HIGH multiple on TROUGH earnings, purchased at the 52-week high on a war premium the macro desk explicitly says not to chase. No variant perception can be named → free kill. Primary sources reachable ✓, but the entry kills it.
